items.prompt: White to move. If White did nothing useful and Black moved next, what would Black play to win material or checkmate? Name that move, or choose 'No threat'.

claims.statement: The knight on e7 is the only White piece that is attacked and undefended.
Exactly one Black piece attacks e7.

hints: Imagine it is the opponent's turn again. Which of their pieces could give check or capture something?
For each of their checks and captures, ask whether something of yours is left without a defender or without a flight square.
The piece on e7 is attacked and has no defender.
items.explain: The knight on e7 is attacked once and defended by nothing, so Black could capture it with Rxe7. A null-move engine search run when the item was built found that this capture nets Black at least 2 points of material; the validator does not re-run that part.
